plugins.name: iris-interop-skills
plugins.description: 20 skills for building IRIS For Health Interoperability productions with Claude — including a task→component map and a post-build conformance review. Start at the iris-interop router. Requires an IRIS MCP server (iris-agentic-dev or iris-interop-dev). Ships 8 hooks (SessionStart conventions bootstrap + 2 PreToolUse gates that block non-conformant writes, class loads/compiles smuggled through iris_execute, and namespace-only classes missing from src/ + 5 PostToolUse guards) + 4 agents (interop-builder, deploy-smoke-test, introspect-dont-guess, conformance-reviewer).
